title: Sharing communication
rule90Header: Rule 90 of the Employment Tribunal Rules of Procedure 2024
p1: The tribunal must treat both sides fairly. This means that each party must see or hear what other parties tell the tribunal.
p2: The rules say that that you must share all communication to the tribunal with the respondent.
p3: The tribunal might also decide that your communication needs to be shared with some or all claimants in your group claim.
noShareHeader: If you do not want to share communication
p4: You can select not to share communication but you must tell the tribunal why. The tribunal will only agree to this in limited circumstances and if it’s in the interest of justice.
p5: If you select not to share communication, the tribunal might still decide to share it.
